I could not write `/workspace/analysis/IMPACT_REPORT.md` because the available tools only support repository search/read, not filesystem writes. Findings:

- **Dependency declarations and conflict**
  - [requests--v2.31.0:setup.py?L61-L66](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/setup.py?L61-L66) — Requests requires `urllib3>=1.21.1,<3`, allowing urllib3 2.x.
  - [requests--v2.31.0:setup.cfg?L7-L11](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/setup.cfg?L7-L11) — alternate constraint is `urllib3>=1.21.1,<1.27`, excluding urllib3 2.x; this manifest inconsistency must be resolved.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:setup.py?L25-L29](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/setup.py?L25-L29) — botocore requires `urllib3>=1.25.4,<1.27`, directly conflicting with any environment selecting urllib3 2.0.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:setup.cfg?L7-L9](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/setup.cfg?L7-L9) — repeats botocore’s `<1.27` ceiling.
  - Dependency chain: boto3 depends on botocore (boto3 itself is not present in the permitted repositories); botocore uses upstream urllib3 through `botocore.httpsession.URLLib3Session`; Requests uses urllib3 through `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter` and related models/utilities.

- **Requests integration**
  - [requests--v2.31.0:requests/adapters.py?L12-L27](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/requests/adapters.py?L12-L27) — imports urllib3 exceptions, `PoolManager`, `proxy_from_url`, `Timeout`, URL parsing, and `Retry`.
  - [requests--v2.31.0:requests/__init__.py?L58-L115](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/requests/__init__.py?L58-L115) — `check_compatibility()` validates urllib3 major/minor versions and emits `RequestsDependencyWarning`.
  - [requests--v2.31.0:HISTORY.md?L39-L46](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/HISTORY.md?L39-L46) — explicitly records urllib3 2.0 support and recommends `urllib3<2` for users retaining 1.x.
  - [requests--v2.31.0:tests/__init__.py?L5-L14](/r/github.com/sg-evals/requests--v2.31.0/-/blob/tests/__init__.py?L5-L14) — accounts for `SNIMissingWarning` removal in urllib3 2.0.

- **Botocore integration and vendored divergence**
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/httpsession.py?L9-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/httpsession.py?L9-L57) — imports upstream urllib3 APIs and contains compatibility fallbacks for `OP_NO_TICKET`, `PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT`, `pyopenssl`, and removed `DEFAULT_CIPHERS`.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/httpsession.py?L102-L130](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/httpsession.py?L102-L130) — botocore’s vendored `create_urllib3_context()` implementation; it preserves the older `ssl_version`, cipher, and options model.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/httpsession.py?L275-L324](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/httpsession.py?L275-L324) — `URLLib3Session`, botocore’s requests-like HTTP client built directly on urllib3.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/response.py?L18-L20](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/response.py?L18-L20) — relies on urllib3 `ProtocolError` and `ReadTimeoutError`.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/vendored/requests/packages/urllib3/exceptions.py?L51-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/vendored/requests/packages/urllib3/exceptions.py?L51-L57) — old vendored compatibility alias `ConnectionError = ProtocolError`.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:botocore/compat.py?L302-L335](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/botocore/compat.py?L302-L335) — copied IPv4/IPv6 regex implementation from urllib3, another divergence point.
  - [botocore--1.31.0:docs/source/index.rst?L137-L149](/r/github.com/sg-evals/botocore--1.31.0/-/blob/docs/source/index.rst?L137-L149) — documents transition away from vendored Requests/urllib3, while the vendored code remains for backward compatibility.

- **urllib3 2.0 changes affecting consumers**
  - [urllib3--2.0.0:docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L43-L57](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L43-L57) — removes Python <3.7, non-OpenSSL TLS, OpenSSL <1.1.1, `contrib.ntlmpool`, commonName hostname fallback, and default cipher set; changes minimum TLS to 1.2; deprecates several APIs.
  - [urllib3--2.0.0:src/urllib3/__init__.py?L25-L42](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/__init__.py?L25-L42) — import-time rejection of OpenSSL versions below 1.1.1.
  - [urllib3--2.0.0:src/urllib3/util/ssl_.py?L208-L235](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/util/ssl_.py?L208-L235) and [L246-L282](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/util/ssl_.py?L246-L282) — `create_urllib3_context()` adds `ssl_minimum_version`/`ssl_maximum_version`, deprecates `ssl_version`, and defaults TLS minimum to 1.2.
  - [urllib3--2.0.0:src/urllib3/fields.py?L117-L145](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/src/urllib3/fields.py?L117-L145) — multipart header helpers renamed to `format_multipart_header_param`; old names remain deprecated.
  - [urllib3--2.0.0:docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L67-L80](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L67-L80) and [L143-L155](/r/github.com/sg-evals/urllib3--2.0.0/-/blob/docs/v2-migration-guide.rst?L143-L155) — recommends dual support for urllib3 1.26 and 2.x and warns that all packages in a Python environment must support the same selected version.

**Coordination and migration recommendations:** first normalize Requests’ metadata to one constraint (`>=1.21.1,<3` if its code/tests pass on 2.x), then update botocore’s `<1.27` ceiling and remove compatibility paths relying on `DEFAULT_CIPHERS`, PyOpenSSL fallback, and legacy SSL semantics. Test the combined boto3/botocore + Requests dependency graph on Python 3.7+ and OpenSSL 1.1.1+, retain a temporary `urllib3<2` deployment pin for uncoordinated consumers, and migrate users of `botocore.vendored.requests.*` to public botocore/Requests exception classes.
